tags.name: pixel-adjust
tags.description: A pixel effect: brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue.

attributes.name: brightness
attributes.description: Multiplier: 1 is unchanged, 0 is black. Default 1.

attributes.name: contrast
attributes.description: Multiplier around mid-gray: 1 is unchanged, 0 is flat gray. Default 1.

attributes.name: saturation
attributes.description: Multiplier: 1 is unchanged, 0 is grayscale. Default 1.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.description: Rotation in degrees. Default 0.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-canvas
tags.description:
Pixel effects on any image, video, canvas, or pixel sprite.

Events: `play`, `pause`, `load`, `framechange`, `palettechange`, `error`

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Working width in pixels: the source is scaled to it (keeping its aspect ratio) before the effects run. Smaller is faster and chunkier. Default: the source's own width.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Working height, if `width` isn't given.

attributes.name: effects
attributes.description: Effects to apply, in order, like CSS `filter`: `mosaic(4) palette(gameboy, ordered) adjust(contrast 1.3)`. They run after any effect elements inside.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: Publish the result's N most common colors as `--pixel-swatch-1` … `--pixel-swatch-N` custom properties (and the `palette` property). Default: none.

attributes.name: swatches-target
attributes.description: A selector for more elements to set those custom properties on (for example `html`, to theme the page). They're always set on the `<pixel-canvas>` itself.

attributes.name: fps
attributes.description: Redraw at this rate, so effects that change over time (`glitch`, `wave`, your own) animate even on a still image. Without it, it redraws only when something changes (or every frame of a playing video).

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Stops the clock effects animate by, and the `fps` redraws. Reflects; write it in markup to start paused.

attributes.name: html
attributes.description: Experimental: draw its own HTML content (live, and still interactive) through the effects, where the browser supports HTML-in-canvas; elsewhere the content shows as it is. Without `width`/`height`, one working pixel is one CSS pixel.

attributes.name: gpu
attributes.description: Run the effects on the GPU (WebGL2) when every effect in the chain can: the source is uploaded once and nothing is read back (unless `swatches` needs it). Otherwise, or without WebGL2, they run on the CPU as usual. `renderer` says which ran.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: Animate changes to `effects` over this long (`400ms`, `0.5s`): numbers in the same effects are interpolated; a different list of effects cross-fades. Not for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

tags.name: pixel-chroma-key
tags.description: A pixel effect: make a color transparent (green screen).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The color to remove, any CSS color. Default `lime`.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: How different a color can be and still be removed, 0–1. Default 0.3.

attributes.name: softness
attributes.description: A fade beyond the tolerance, 0–1, for smooth edges. Default 0.1.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-crt
tags.description: A pixel effect: an old CRT screen.

attributes.name: scanlines
attributes.description: How much alternate rows are darkened, 0–1. Default 0.35.

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: Strength of the color stripe mask, 0–1. Default 0.25.

attributes.name: glow
attributes.description: Overall brightness boost. Default 1.15.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-glitch
tags.description: A pixel effect: animated digital glitches.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: How broken, 0 (none) to 1. Default 0.3.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: New glitches per second of the canvas clock. Default 8.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-glyphs
tags.description: A pixel effect: the image as text characters (ASCII art).

attributes.name: cell
attributes.description: Cell size in working pixels, `8x12` (the default) or `10` for square. 2–32 a side.

attributes.name: chars
attributes.description: The characters to use: a set (`ramp`, the default for brightness; `ascii`, the default for shape; `blocks`; `binary`) or your own, quoted when it has spaces or commas (`' .:#'`).

attributes.name: font
attributes.description: A CSS font family. Default `monospace`.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Choose by how much ink a character has (`brightness`, the default) or where its ink is (`shape`: lines and edges get matching characters).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The ink: `source` (each cell's own color, the default) or a CSS color.

attributes.name: background
attributes.description: Behind the characters: `none` (transparent, the default) or a CSS color. On a light background, darkness is inked.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-grid
tags.description: A pixel effect: grid lines between cells.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Cell size, in the working image's pixels. Default 8.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Line color, any CSS color (transparency blends). `transparent` cuts gaps instead of drawing lines. Default `rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)`.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Line thickness in pixels. Default 1.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-halftone
tags.description: A pixel effect: halftone dots, like print.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Cell size in pixels. Default 6.

attributes.name: angle
attributes.description: Grid angle in degrees. Default 45.

attributes.name: ink
attributes.description: Dot color, any CSS color, or `auto` for each cell's own color. Default black.

attributes.name: paper
attributes.description: Background color. Default white.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-lens
tags.description: A pixel effect: a magnifying glass at the pointer.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The lens's radius, in working pixels. Default 24.

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: How much it enlarges. Default 2.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-mosaic
tags.description: A pixel effect: pixelate into blocks of one color.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Block size, in the working image's pixels. Default 8.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-outline
tags.description: A pixel effect: line art from edges.

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: Edge strength needed for a line, 0–1. Lower draws more lines. Default 0.2.

attributes.name: ink
attributes.description: Line color. Default black.

attributes.name: paper
attributes.description: Background color, or `none` to draw the lines over the image. Default white.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-palette
tags.description: A pixel effect: limit colors to a palette, with dithering.

attributes.name: colors
attributes.description: A named palette (`1bit`, `gameboy`, `grayscale`, `cga`, `sepia`, `pico-8`), space-separated CSS colors, or `auto` (the image's own dominant colors). Default `1bit`.

attributes.name: dither
attributes.description: `none` (default), `floyd-steinberg` (error diffusion), or `ordered` (a 4×4 Bayer pattern).

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: With `colors="auto"`: how many colors to pick. Default 8.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-shader
tags.description: A pixel effect written as a GLSL fragment shader, run on the GPU.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-spotlight
tags.description: A pixel effect: a spotlight that follows the pointer.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The lit circle's radius, in working pixels. Default 32.

attributes.name: softness
attributes.description: How far the light fades out beyond the radius. Default 16.

attributes.name: dim
attributes.description: How dark the rest gets, 0–1. Default 0.7.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.

tags.name: pixel-sprite
tags.description:
Pixel art written as text, with animation frames.

Events: `play`, `pause`, `framechange`

attributes.name: colors
attributes.description: What each character means: `char color` pairs separated by `;` (`. transparent; # black; o gold`), or a named palette whose colors are numbered `0`–`9` then `a`–`z` (`pico-8`, the default; `gameboy`; `1bit`; …). `.` is transparent unless you say otherwise.

attributes.name: fps
attributes.description: Play the frames at this rate. Without it (or with one frame), it's still.

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Whether the animation is paused. Reflects; write it in markup to start paused.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: A text alternative, as on ``. An empty `alt` marks it decorative.

tags.name: pixel-wave
tags.description: A pixel effect: an animated wave.

attributes.name: amplitude
attributes.description: How far rows move, in pixels. Default 4.

attributes.name: wavelength
attributes.description: Rows per wave. Default 32.

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: Waves per second on the canvas clock (negative reverses). Default 0.5.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.
